notes: v2.9.27 - Patient-safety write guards + review screen. The extension now hard-refuses to click Sign, Sign off, Submit, Send, Approve, Finalize, Place order, Prescribe or Transmit at four independent layers (an explicit forbidden-control list enforced in code, not hidden UI); orders, prescriptions, referrals, billing and diagnoses are preview-only everywhere. New extension-side review screen shows exactly what is proposed, where in Athena it would go, its category, and whether it is safe / preview-only / needs manual action. Test content policy: only Adam J Schaeffer (7833832) can receive TEST-marked content, which must carry a TEST marker and no real medication/order/instruction language. Teach Destination now remembers destinations per practice+provider+section, detects Athena layout changes instead of writing to a stale guess, and supports a read-only dry-run. The athenanet synthetic-click interceptor ships in MONITOR mode (logs, never consumes) until live QA arms it. Reads and pulls unchanged.
